q: ChatGPT 设计题的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 发送自然语言 prompt 并收到 AI 回复
查看历史聊天并带着上下文继续对话
编辑或分叉已有消息
跨聊天全文搜索历史记录
why: 本题只覆盖文本对话和历史续聊；编辑、分叉、全文搜索、多模态、工具调用都被放到范围外。先收紧范围，才能把时间花在流式返回、GPU 调度和成本控制上。
why_en: The scoped product requirements are sending text prompts and resuming saved chats with prior context, while editing, branching, search, tools, and multimodal features are out of scope.
options_en: Send a natural-language prompt and get an AI reply.
View past chats and resume them with prior context.
Edit or branch existing messages.
Full-text search across chat history.

q: 哪些内容在本题里明确 below the line？（多选）
options: 保存最终 assistant message
逐 token 持久化每个流式 chunk
鉴权、滥用治理和内容审核细节
GDPR、数据驻留、隐私合规
why: 系统只需要持久化最终回复，不要求每个 token 都成为 durable record；安全、合规、监控等也不是主线。这样深挖可以集中在 serving 系统本身。
why_en: Per-token durability, moderation, compliance, and operations are scoped out so the design can focus on low-latency serving and GPU capacity.
options_en: Persist only the final assistant message.
Persist every streamed token chunk individually.
Authentication, abuse prevention, and moderation details.
GDPR, data residency, and privacy compliance.

q: 这个规模量级最直接支持下面哪个设计判断？
options: GPU 调度和利用率必须被认真设计
并发流不多，同步阻塞调用完全够用
单实例 Postgres 就能撑住所有读写流量
这个规模下不需要考虑排队或降级
why: 200M DAU、约 20k prompts/sec 峰值、120k 并发流意味着 GPU 调度和利用率才是这题的核心难点，而不是常规 CRUD 扩展。
why_en: At roughly 200 million daily users and 120 thousand concurrent streams, GPU scheduling and utilization become the central design problem, not ordinary CRUD scaling.
scenario: 设计题设定 ChatGPT 服务约 200M DAU、峰值约 20k prompts/sec、约 120k 并发生成流。
options_en: GPU scheduling and cross-request utilization need serious design, this is not ordinary CRUD scale.
Concurrency is low enough that synchronous blocking calls are fine.
A single Postgres instance can handle all read/write traffic.
At this scale there is no need to think about queuing or degradation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，衡量每天有多少用户使用产品。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU is the number of unique users active on a given day.

q: 本题最关键的用户感知延迟指标是什么？
options: 数据库写入操作的 p99 延迟
首 token 延迟（TTFT）低于约 500ms
完整回复必须在 2 秒内结束
模型训练阶段的吞吐量指标
why: 用户按下回车后最怕看到空白，所以 TTFT 比完整生成耗时更影响体验；完整回复仍可持续到约 30 秒。
why_en: Time to first token under roughly 500 milliseconds matters more than total completion time because a blank screen feels broken.
scenario: 用户敲回车后期待立刻看到反应；产品目标是让首个 token 尽快出现，完整回复允许持续到约 30 秒。
options_en: Database write p99 latency.
Time to first token (TTFT) under about 500ms.
The full response must finish within 2 seconds.
Model training throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从发送请求到第一枚 token 出现的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTFT is the time from sending a request to the first token appearing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 的请求都能在这个时间内完成的延迟阈值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 latency is the threshold that 99 percent of requests complete within.

q: 对 conversation state，应该选择哪种 CAP 倾向？
options: 强一致优先，宁可整体阻塞
完全不持久化聊天状态
可用性优先，接受短暂状态不一致或降级
所有地区同步提交后才响应
why: 聊天状态不是股票交易这类强一致场景，短暂降级或返回错误比让整个系统等完美同步更好。目标是约 99.9%+ 可用性。
why_en: Conversation state favors availability over strong consistency because temporary degradation is preferable to blocking the whole system.
tradeoff: 可用性 vs 强一致性（CAP）
options_en: Prioritize strong consistency, even if it blocks the whole system.
Do not persist conversation state at all.
Prioritize availability and accept brief state inconsistency or degradation.
Only respond after every region commits synchronously.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性、可用性、分区容忍性三者在网络分区下不可兼得的经典权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAP describes the trade-off among consistency, availability, and partition tolerance during a network partition.

scenario: ChatGPT 需要保存和展示会话历史，但它不是转账、下单这类必须强一致的系统。

q: 补全 ChatGPT 的基础实体：
text: 基础实体包括 {{User}}（带 free/paid tier）、{{Chat}}（单个对话线程）、{{Message}}（user 或 assistant 的一轮消息）；深挖后还会引入 {{Generation}} 表示一次推理运行。
why: User tier 后面影响公平调度，Chat 和 Message 支撑历史续聊。Generation 一开始不是必须实体，但当 runId、状态、取消、计费都出现后就值得建模。
why_en: The base entities are User, Chat, and Message, with Generation added later once an inference run needs its own lifecycle.

q: ChatGPT 的基础 API 需要覆盖哪些路径？（多选）
options: POST /chats 创建聊天
POST /chats/{chatId}/messages 发送 prompt 并流式返回
GET /chats 和 GET /chats/{chatId}/messages 分页读取历史
客户端在 body 里传 userId 让服务端信任
why: 创建、发送、历史列表和消息读取分别映射到 Chat 与 Message；userId 必须从 session/JWT 推导并做 ownership check。把 userId 放进请求体是可伪造的红旗。
why_en: The API covers creating chats, sending streamed messages, and paginated reads, while user identity must come from trusted auth context rather than the body.
options_en: POST /chats creates a new chat.
POST /chats/{chatId}/messages sends a prompt and streams the reply back.
GET /chats and GET /chats/{chatId}/messages paginate through history.
The client passes userId in the body and the server trusts it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端签发的身份令牌，用来在请求间证明用户身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A JWT is a signed token issued by the server that proves user identity across requests.

scenario: 聊天状态的读写是普通行存储，推理层则依赖昂贵 GPU，并且两者的扩缩容节奏完全不同。
q: 为什么要拆出 Chat Service 和 Inference Service？
options: 让每条消息都写两个数据库
让客户端直接接管 GPU worker 的调度
为了完全不保存任何聊天历史记录
让编排层和 GPU 推理层能各自独立扩缩容与调度
why: Chat Service 负责认证后的编排和消息持久化，Inference Service 拥有 GPU worker。拆分后可以独立扩容、排队、调度 GPU，而不让普通请求层被 GPU 约束绑死。
why_en: Separating chat orchestration from GPU inference lets the cheap stateless tier and expensive worker tier scale and schedule independently.
whenOtherWins: 很小的内部 demo 可以把调用写在一个服务里；一旦 GPU 成为瓶颈，边界就必须清晰。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Chat[Chat Service]
Chat --> DB[(Chat DB)]
Chat --> Queue[Inference Queue]
Queue --> Worker[GPU Worker]
Worker --> Model[LLM Runtime]
tradeoff: 编排层与推理层独立扩缩容 vs 单服务实现简单
options_en: Route every message through two databases.
Let the client manage GPU workers directly.
Avoid persisting any chat history at all.
Let the cheap orchestration tier and the expensive GPU tier scale independently.

q: 把同步 MVP 的发送流程排成正确顺序：
steps: Chat Service 同步调用 Inference Service 并等待完整 completion
API Gateway 鉴权后转发给 Chat Service
客户端 POST /chats/{chatId}/messages
Chat Service 写入用户消息
Chat Service 写入 assistant message 并返回
why: 这个流程满足功能需求，但用户会等到完整回复生成完才看到结果。它故意暴露出 TTFT 和 admission control 两个后续深挖点。
why_en: The synchronous MVP works functionally but exposes blank-screen latency and missing admission control as the core problems.

scenario: 要存储 chats 和 messages，查询主要按 userId、chatId、createdAt 读取，数据模型简单且关系明确。
q: 系统记录最合适的默认存储是什么？
options: Postgres
Elasticsearch
Redis Pub/Sub
本地文件系统
why: 聊天与消息是简单、可索引、需要持久化的行数据，Postgres 是稳妥默认选择。文章也强调这里不是数据库选型难点，几乎任何合理持久化数据库都能工作。
why_en: Postgres is a sensible system of record because chats and messages are simple durable rows keyed by user and chat.
whenOtherWins: 如果核心需求变成跨历史全文搜索，Elasticsearch 会作为搜索索引补上；Redis Pub/Sub 不是 durable source of truth。
tradeoff: 简单持久化行存储 vs 全文搜索能力
options_en: Postgres.
Elasticsearch.
Redis Pub/Sub.
The local filesystem.

q: 每轮都把完整历史拼进 prompt 的主要后果是什么？
options: 模型处理请求永远不会超出上下文窗口限制
输入成本和延迟随对话增长，最终撞上上下文窗口上限
可以完全不保存任何历史消息记录
会自动大幅提升 GPU 利用率表现
why: 全量历史是最简单的“记住对话”，但每轮都重复付费读取旧内容。长对话会同时带来成本、延迟和上下文窗口上限问题。
why_en: Replaying full history makes memory simple but causes input cost and prefill latency to grow until the context window is exceeded.
options_en: The model will never exceed its context window.
Input cost and latency grow with the conversation and eventually hit the context window limit.
It is fine to persist no message history at all.
It automatically raises GPU utilization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型处理输入 prompt、生成第一枚输出 token 之前的计算阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefill is the compute phase where the model processes the input prompt before producing the first output token.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型单次能处理的最大 token 数量上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The context window is the maximum number of tokens a model can process in one call.

scenario: 浏览器只需要在生成期间持续接收 token，prompt 已经通过 POST 发出，中途只有取消请求需要单独处理。
q: 对浏览器侧 token 推送，最贴合的传输方案是？
options: 短轮询 status endpoint
UDP 组播
Server-Sent Events
每个 token 一个独立 HTTP 请求
why: SSE 是一条普通 HTTP 响应上的单向 server-to-client 流，正好匹配 token 下发。它避免 WebSocket 的双向状态成本，同时比轮询更快更平滑。
why_en: SSE fits token streaming because the browser only needs a one-way server-to-client stream after the prompt is submitted.
whenOtherWins: 如果客户端需要在同一连接上频繁双向交互，WebSocket 会更合适；如果只是低频状态检查，轮询也能接受。
tradeoff: 单向 server-push 简单性 vs 双向连接开销
options_en: Short-poll a status endpoint.
UDP multicast.
Server-Sent Events.
One separate HTTP request per token.
optionDirectness: 轮询有间隔延迟，达不到低 TTFT 要求
不保证送达，也非浏览器标准 API
单向推送，天然匹配只发不收的 token 流
每 token 建连接，开销随速率线性爆炸
optionDirectness_en: Polling has interval delay, missing the low-TTFT target.
No delivery guarantee, and not a standard browser API.
One-way push, a natural fit for a send-only token stream.
One connection per token, overhead explodes with rate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器向浏览器单向推送事件的 HTTP 流机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Server-Sent Events let a server push a one-way stream of events to the browser over plain HTTP.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不保证送达、无连接的传输层协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UDP is a connectionless transport protocol that does not guarantee delivery.

q: 为什么几百毫秒轮询不适合 LLM token 流？
options: 轮询请求完全无法穿过负载均衡器
轮询方式只能在移动端使用
它要求把每个 token 都写入 Postgres
TTFT 被轮询间隔卡住，且请求量暴增
why: 120k 并发流每 300ms 轮询约等于 400k RPS，且多数为空响应。第一 token 还要等下一次 poll，用户看到的是一坨一坨出现而不是平滑流。
why_en: Polling delays the first token by the poll interval, creates huge mostly-empty request volume, and makes the stream arrive in chunks.
options_en: Polling requests cannot pass through a load balancer at all.
Polling only works on mobile clients.
It requires writing every token to Postgres.
TTFT is capped by the poll interval and request volume explodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从请求发出到第一个 token 出现的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTFT is the time from a request being sent to the first token appearing on screen.

scenario: GPU worker 要把 token 一个个推给 Chat Service，两个都是内部服务，需要类型化契约和高效复用连接。
q: 内部 worker → Chat Service 流最合适的协议是什么？
options: gRPC server-streaming
浏览器 EventSource
每个 token 写一次数据库再轮询
电子邮件 webhook
why: gRPC over HTTP/2 提供二进制 framing、连接复用和 protobuf 契约，适合服务间 stream。SSE 更适合浏览器边界，不是内部 worker API 的首选。
why_en: gRPC server streaming is a good internal hop because it gives efficient HTTP/2 multiplexing and a typed service contract.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是浏览器展示 token，SSE 更轻；如果 worker 只返回完整结果，普通 request/response 就够。
tradeoff: 服务间高效双工契约 vs 浏览器单向推送简单性
options_en: gRPC server-streaming.
Browser EventSource.
Write each token to the database and poll it.
Email webhook.
optionDirectness: HTTP/2 二进制流 + 多路复用，服务间效率最高
为浏览器边缘设计，不是内部服务契约
把流式请求硬拗成同步写库加轮询
邮件不是低延迟通道，也没有流式语义
optionDirectness_en: HTTP/2 binary streaming with multiplexing, most efficient between services.
Built for the browser edge, not an internal service contract.
Forces a streaming request into synchronous writes plus polling.
Email is not a low-latency channel and has no streaming semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 HTTP/2 的服务间 RPC 框架，支持二进制 framing 和流式调用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is an HTTP/2-based RPC framework for service-to-service calls that supports streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器用来接收 SSE 推送的原生 API。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EventSource is the browser API that receives a Server-Sent Events stream.

q: 补全浏览器与内部服务两段流的选择：
text: 浏览器接收 token 用 {{SSE}}，因为它是单向 HTTP 推送；Inference Worker 到 Chat Service 用 {{gRPC server-streaming}}，因为它是服务间类型化流。
why: 两段流解决的是不同边界：用户边界追求简单兼容，内部边界追求高效契约。不要把一种协议硬套到所有连接上。
why_en: The browser edge uses SSE while the internal worker hop uses gRPC server streaming because each boundary has different protocol needs.

q: 让一个 Chat Service 实例同时持有 client SSE 和 worker gRPC 流的主要风险是什么？
options: Postgres 无法写入 assistant 消息
部署/崩溃/扩缩容会切断长连接，还绑死 worker
浏览器无法正确显示中文字符
GPU 会自动进入空闲状态
why: 这个方案把无状态服务变成长连接中继，pod 替换会杀掉用户正在看的流。下一步需要让 worker 和持连接的 Chat Service 通过 runId 解耦。
why_en: Pinning a stream to one Chat Service instance makes deployments and crashes break long-lived generations and couples that instance to a worker.
scenario: Chat Service 是无状态、水平扩展的服务，会被频繁重新部署或自动扩缩容。
options_en: Postgres cannot write the assistant message.
Deploys, crashes, or autoscaling cut long connections and pin the instance to one worker.
The browser cannot render Chinese characters.
The GPU automatically goes idle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务器向浏览器单向推送的 HTTP 流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE is a one-way HTTP push stream from server to browser.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 HTTP/2 的服务间流式 RPC 框架。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: gRPC is an HTTP/2-based streaming RPC framework used between services.

scenario: worker 生成 token 的节点和持有浏览器 SSE 的 Chat Service 实例可能不是同一个，客户端重连后也可能落到新实例。
q: 第一步解耦 worker 和 Chat Service 可以用什么？
options: 把每个 token 当新消息写入 Postgres
强制所有请求 sticky 到同一个 pod 上
按 runId 建 Redis Pub/Sub 频道解耦生成和连接
让浏览器直接连上 GPU worker
why: runId channel 让生成方和连接方只在逻辑 stream 上汇合，不关心彼此具体实例。这样重连后任意 Chat Service 都能订阅同一个 runId。
why_en: A runId-keyed pub/sub channel decouples token producers from whichever Chat Service instance holds the client connection.
whenOtherWins: 如果连接和 worker 生命周期很短且不会重连，直接中继更简单；如果需要 durable replay，纯 Pub/Sub 又不够。
tradeoff: 生成方与连接方解耦 vs 直接绑定的简单性
options_en: Write each token as a new Postgres message.
Force every request to stick to the same pod.
Create a runId-keyed Redis Pub/Sub channel to decouple generation from the connection.
Let the browser connect directly to the GPU worker.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式，发布者广播消息给当前在线的订阅者。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub is a publish-subscribe pattern where publishers broadcast to whichever subscribers are currently connected.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识一次生成过程的唯一 ID，用来让生成方和连接方在逻辑上汇合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: runId is the unique identifier for one generation that lets producers and connections rendezvous logically.

q: Redis Pub/Sub 用在 token 流上的致命缺口是什么？
options: 它会自动把 delta 变成全量文本
它只能存储永久消息
它不能按 runId 命名 channel
没有订阅者时消息不缓存，重连间隙发布的 token 会丢
why: Pub/Sub 是 fire-and-forget，只投递给当时在线的订阅者。部署或网络闪断期间丢的 delta 会让用户看到答案中间缺一段。
why_en: Redis Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget, so tokens published during a reconnect gap are lost to the live stream.
options_en: It automatically turns deltas into the full text.
It can only store permanent messages.
It cannot name a channel by runId.
Messages are not buffered, so tokens published during a reconnect gap are lost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式，只投递给当时在线的订阅者，不做持久化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub delivers messages only to subscribers connected at publish time and does not persist them.

scenario: 需要保持 runId 解耦，但客户端断线重连后必须补上 missed token，而不是等最终消息完成后再整体 refetch。
q: 应该把 token delta 写到哪里？
options: Redis Stream，按 last-seen ID 用 XREAD 续读
Redis Pub/Sub，完全不保留历史记录
把每个 token 写一行 Postgres 当主路径
存进浏览器本地的 localStorage 里
why: Redis Stream 是短期 append-only log，XADD 每个 delta，XREAD 可从 last-seen ID 继续。它只为直播恢复服务，最终消息仍由 Postgres 持久化。
why_en: Redis Streams preserve short-lived token deltas so reconnecting clients can resume from the last seen entry without gaps.
whenOtherWins: 如果允许流中间丢 token、只关心最终结果，Pub/Sub 更简单；如果每个 token 都是合规记录，才考虑 durable database path。
tradeoff: 可重放的短期日志 vs fire-and-forget 广播
options_en: Redis Streams; Chat Service resumes with XREAD from the last-seen entry ID.
Redis Pub/Sub, keeping no history.
Write each token as one Postgres row on the main path.
The browser's localStorage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的 append-only 日志结构，可按 ID 顺序重放。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Redis Stream is an append-only log that can be replayed in order by entry ID.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从 Redis Stream 按位置读取新条目的命令。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: XREAD is the Redis command that reads new stream entries from a given position.

scenario: worker 已经生成一个 token delta，需要把它追加到 runId 的短期流里，供任意 Chat Service 重放。
q: 哪条 Redis 命令最贴合这个写入？
options: PUBLISH gen:{runId} "hello"
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello"
SET gen:{runId} "hello"
LPUSH gen:{runId} "hello"
codeSample:
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello"
XREAD BLOCK 5000 STREAMS gen:{runId} {lastSeenId}
why: XADD 追加带 ID 的条目，XREAD 可以从 lastSeenId 继续读取，正好支持重连补洞。PUBLISH 更轻但不会保存错过的 token。
why_en: XADD plus XREAD gives each token a stream entry ID, which lets a reconnecting client replay exactly the missed deltas.
whenOtherWins: 只做实时广播且允许断线丢消息时，PUBLISH 更省；只保存最终回复时，SET/数据库写入是另一个层次。
tradeoff: 可重放的 append-only 日志 vs 更轻量但不持久的广播
options_en: PUBLISH gen:{runId} "hello".
XADD gen:{runId} * token "hello".
SET gen:{runId} "hello".
LPUSH gen:{runId} "hello".

termDefinitions.meaning: 向 Redis Stream 追加一条带 ID 的新条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: XADD appends a new ID-stamped entry to a Redis Stream.

q: 补全 token 负载选择的原因：
text: token stream 应发布 {{delta}} 而不是 message-so-far，因为重复发送不断增长的完整前缀会让带宽接近 {{quadratic}} 开销。
why: 4,000 token 回复如果每次都发完整文本，会反复发送旧前缀。delta 让每个 token 只跨网络一次。
why_en: Streaming deltas avoids repeatedly sending the growing prefix, which would make bandwidth scale roughly quadratically with answer length.

q: 把最终 token streaming 流程排成正确顺序：
steps: 客户端打开 runId 的 SSE 连接，落到任意 Chat Service
worker 生成 token 并 XADD 到 runId 的 Redis Stream
Chat Service 持久化用户消息并生成 runId
Chat Service XREAD 新条目并转发给浏览器
连接断开后新实例从 last-seen ID 继续读
why: 关键是 runId 把生成、读取和重连串起来，而 Redis Stream 提供短期 replay。这个流程同时满足低 TTFT 和不中断的 live stream。
why_en: The final streaming path uses runId plus Redis Streams so any Chat Service instance can forward live tokens and replay gaps after reconnects.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] -->|prompt| Chat[Chat Service]
Chat --> Queue[Bounded Queue]
Queue --> GPU[GPU Worker]
GPU -->|XADD deltas| Stream[(Redis Stream)]
Chat -->|XREAD| Stream
Chat -->|SSE| Client

q: 补全 Generation 实体的生命周期字段：
text: Generation 代表一次推理尝试，包含 {{runId}}、chatId/messageId、status（queued/streaming/{{done}}/{{cancelled}}/failed）、model、input/output token count。
why: 一旦需要排队、流式恢复、取消、计费和状态查询，run 就不再只是返回值，而是系统里的实体。它把后续深挖都挂在同一个抽象上。
why_en: Generation becomes a first-class entity once an inference attempt needs status, streaming identity, cancellation, and token accounting.

scenario: 一次生成可能占用昂贵 GPU 30 秒，前端流量有突刺，worker 处理能力固定且远低于峰值提交速率。
q: Chat Service 和 GPU worker 之间应该加入什么？
options: 每个 prompt 新建一台 GPU 机器
客户端直接随机挑 GPU
请求队列，由 worker 有容量时 pull
把 prompt 存进浏览器等待
why: 队列把突刺前端和稳定后端隔开，worker pull 可以天然表达容量。它还给 admission control、tier priority 和 backpressure 留出位置。
why_en: A queue between chat and workers absorbs bursts and lets GPU workers pull only when they have capacity.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务极短且资源充裕，同步调用更简单；如果需要严格实时控制硬件，专用调度器可能取代普通队列。
tradeoff: 请求队列削峰 vs 直接同步调用的简单性
options_en: Spin up a new GPU machine per prompt.
The client randomly picks a GPU directly.
A request queue that workers pull from when they have capacity.
Hold the prompt in the browser and wait.

q: 只有一个无界队列但没有 backpressure 会导致什么？
options: 所有用户马上得到 429
自动减少输入 token 数
GPU 利用率必然为 100% 且公平
持续过载时排队时间无限增长，用户不知道要等几秒还是几分钟
why: 队列只能吸收短暂突刺，不能创造 GPU 容量。队列深度不封顶时，延迟会无上限增长，产品体验变成永远转圈。
why_en: An unbounded queue turns sustained overload into unbounded wait time instead of a clear admission decision.
options_en: All users immediately get a 429.
Input token count is automatically reduced.
GPU utilization is automatically 100 percent and fair.
Under sustained overload, wait time grows unbounded and users cannot tell if it's seconds or minutes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在过载时主动限制或拒绝新请求，避免延迟无限增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is a system deliberately limiting or rejecting new work under overload instead of letting latency grow unbounded.

scenario: GPU 每次前向都要把巨大模型权重流过计算单元，单序列 decode 会让昂贵硬件大部分时间等内存带宽。
q: 提升 LLM worker 利用率的核心 serving 技术是什么？
options: 连续批处理（continuous batching）
每个用户独占 worker
把完整回复先写 Postgres 再发
固定 sleep 让请求变平滑
why: continuous batching 让一个 forward pass 同时推进多条序列一 token，并在序列结束时立刻补入新请求。这样一次读取权重可以服务几十条生成。
why_en: Continuous batching keeps the GPU busy by advancing many sequences per forward pass and replacing finished ones immediately.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型很小、请求稀疏，简单单请求执行足够；高并发大模型 serving 才需要这套复杂调度。
tradeoff: 跨序列共享一次权重读取 vs 单序列独占 GPU
options_en: Continuous batching.
Give every user a dedicated worker.
Write the full reply to Postgres before sending it.
Add a fixed sleep to smooth requests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让多条生成序列共享同一次前向计算，完成的序列立即被新请求替换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Continuous batching advances many generation sequences together in one forward pass and replaces finished ones immediately.

q: 补全 GPU batching 的直觉：
text: LLM decode 常被说成 {{memory-bandwidth}} bound；batching 的收益是一次搬运模型权重，顺手为 {{many sequences}} 各生成一个 token。
why: 权重常驻高带宽显存，但每步仍要流过计算单元。批量越满，同一次权重读取摊到的 token 越多，利用率越高。
why_en: Decode is often memory-bandwidth bound, so batching makes one weight read produce tokens for many sequences.

q: 把带 backpressure 和 continuous batching 的生成调度排成正确顺序：
steps: worker 把请求加入正在运行的 batch
Chat Service 提交带 runId 和 token-cost estimate 的 generation
batch 每步生成 token 并写入 runId stream
admission control 根据队列深度决定接收、延后或拒绝
完成或取消后从 batch 移除并拉取下一项
why: admission control 先决定是否值得排队，worker 只在容量允许时拉取。continuous batching 则在 worker 内部提高每次 forward pass 的产出。
why_en: Admission control bounds waiting while continuous batching increases the amount of useful GPU work per decoding step.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Req[Generation Request] --> Budget[Check token budget]
Budget --> Queue[Tier queue]
Queue --> Batch[Continuous batch]
Batch --> GPU[GPU decode]
GPU --> Stream[Token stream]

q: 为什么普通 requests-per-minute 不是 ChatGPT 公平性的好指标？
options: 限流器技术上无法用 Redis 实现
请求数不等于 GPU 成本，长 prompt 更贵
这种限流只能用于匿名用户
它会强制保存每一个 token
why: LLM 成本主要由输入输出 token 和模型大小决定，不是 HTTP 请求数。按请求限流会让巨大 prompt 低估成本，也会误伤许多短请求。
why_en: Request counts are the wrong fairness unit because GPU cost is driven by token and model compute, not by the number of HTTP calls.
tradeoff: 按 token/compute 计量 vs 按请求数计量
options_en: A limiter technically cannot be built on Redis.
Request count is not GPU cost; a long prompt can cost more than many short ones.
This limiting only applies to anonymous users.
It forces every token to be persisted.

scenario: 一个用户可能发很长 prompt 或要求很长输出，真正稀缺资源是 GPU token compute；同时系统有 free 和 paid tier。
q: 公平与商业优先级的组合策略是什么？
options: 全站共用一个全局 RPM 限流上限
所有用户完全随机排队处理
按用户 token 预算 + tier 优先队列
只按 IP 限流，不区分账号
why: per-user token budget 防止单个重用户吃光资源，tier-aware queue 在容量紧张时让付费用户体验更好。公平和 tier priority 是两件事，分别用不同机制处理。
why_en: Per-user token budgets prevent monopolization while tier-aware queues give paid users priority when capacity is tight.
whenOtherWins: 普通 REST API 的成本近似每请求相同，简单 RPM 或并发上限就可能足够。
tradeoff: 按用户 token 预算 + 分级优先级 vs 全局统一限流
options_en: One global RPM cap for the whole site.
Queue every user in fully random order.
Per-user token/compute budgets plus a tier-aware priority queue.
Rate-limit only by IP, ignoring the account.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户账号的等级（如 free/paid），影响调度优先级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tier is the account level, such as free or paid, that affects scheduling priority.

q: 容量紧张时，对不同 tier 的降级手段包括哪些？（多选）
options: 优先 throttle 或 defer free 用户
把部分 free 请求路由到更小更便宜的模型
付费和免费永远严格同等待遇
给 free 流量保留一个最低容量地板，避免长期饥饿
why: 文章强调付费优先但不能让 free 永久饿死。常见策略是限流、延后、降模型，同时保留最低份额。
why_en: Degradation can throttle, defer, or downgrade free traffic first while reserving a floor so it is not starved indefinitely.
options_en: Throttle or defer free-tier users first.
Route some free requests to a smaller, cheaper model.
Paid and free users always get strictly equal treatment.
Reserve a minimum capacity floor for free traffic so it is never starved.

q: 为什么 token budget 必须允许事后 reconcile？
options: SSE 协议无法携带 token 内容
Redis 数据库无法存储整数类型
付费用户完全不需要用量 quota
输出长度只能估计，真实值等完成才知道
why: 提交时只能根据 prompt 长度和 max output 估算成本，实际输出到结束才确定。软预算可以先 admission，完成后按真实用量校正。
why_en: Token budgets need reconciliation because output length is only estimated before generation and known after completion.
options_en: SSE cannot carry token content.
Redis cannot store integers.
Paid users need no usage quota at all.
Output length can only be estimated before completion, the real count is known afterward.
optionDirectness: 这里的 token 指用量单位，与 SSE 传输无关
Redis 原生支持整数计数，这不是限制
付费层同样有更宽松的用量上限
生成前只有估计值，完成后才有真实用量
optionDirectness_en: Here 'token' means a usage unit, unrelated to SSE transport.
Redis natively supports integer counters, this is not a real limit.
Paid tiers still have a wider usage cap, not zero quota.
Before generation only an estimate exists; the real count comes after.

scenario: 长对话每轮都发送完整历史，既贵又可能超出 context window，但用户仍希望模型记得早期内容。
q: 最合理的组合方案是什么？
options: 摘要 + 最近原文 + prefix caching
只保留最近 N 轮，旧内容全部丢弃
每轮都发送全量历史，直到报错失败
把所有旧消息塞进 response header
why: summary 压缩旧上下文，最近原文保留高价值细节，prefix caching 让稳定前缀便宜。三者一起控制窗口、成本和记忆质量。
why_en: A rolling summary plus recent verbatim turns plus prefix caching balances memory quality, context-window limits, and input cost.
whenOtherWins: 短对话可以直接全量历史；一次性匿名问答可以只用当前 prompt；强事实检索场景还可加 retrieval。
diagram:
flowchart LR
History[Recent messages] --> Builder[Prompt builder]
Summary[Rolling summary] --> Builder
Docs[Retrieved context] --> Builder
Builder --> Model[LLM]
Model --> Reply[Assistant reply]
tradeoff: 分层记忆（摘要+原文+前缀缓存） vs 简单截断
options_en: A rolling summary plus recent verbatim turns plus prefix caching.
Keep only the last N turns and drop everything older.
Send the full history every turn until it fails.
Stuff all old messages into a response header.

termDefinitions.meaning: 复用稳定 prompt 前缀已算好的 KV cache，避免重复计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prefix caching reuses the already-computed KV cache for a stable prompt prefix instead of recomputing it.

scenario: 为了快速给一个长对话做成本上限，先只取最近 N 条消息，但仍要保持模型看到的顺序正确。
q: 这段查询后还必须做什么？
options: 直接按 DESC 顺序喂给模型
把结果再翻回 createdAt 升序后拼 prompt
删除所有 assistant 消息
把 LIMIT 改成无穷大
codeSample:
SELECT * FROM messages
WHERE chatId = $1
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT $2;
why: DESC + LIMIT 是为了拿最新 N 条，拼 prompt 时必须恢复时间正序。否则模型会先看到未来回复再看到旧问题，语义会乱。
why_en: The newest rows are fetched descending for efficiency, but the prompt must be assembled in chronological order.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据库支持反向窗口后稳定排序，也可以在查询层直接返回正序；全量历史短小时不需要 LIMIT。
tradeoff: 恢复时间正序保证语义 vs 直接使用查询返回顺序
options_en: Feed the model the rows in DESC order as returned.
Flip the rows back to ascending createdAt order before building the prompt.
Delete all assistant messages.
Change LIMIT to unbounded.

q: 最近 N 轮截断相比 rolling summary 的主要问题是什么？
options: 截断成本不固定
截断会增加输出 token 数
旧事实会突然消失，用户会感觉模型失忆
summary 不能和 prefix caching 共存
why: 只保留最近 N 轮能硬控成本，但第 N+1 轮外的信息直接丢失。summary 用有损压缩保留旧上下文的 gist，体验更连续。
why_en: Recent-turn truncation bounds cost but creates abrupt amnesia, while summaries preserve older context in compressed form.
tradeoff: 硬截断成本可控 vs 摘要保留记忆连续性
options_en: Truncation cost is not fixed.
Truncation increases output token count.
Old facts vanish abruptly and the model feels like it forgot.
Summaries cannot coexist with prefix caching.

q: prefix caching 对 TTFT 和成本的帮助来自哪里？
options: 让 Redis Stream 变成永久持久化存储
把所有输出 token 都缓存进 CDN 节点
减少数据库里存储的行数总量
复用稳定前缀的 KV cache，避免重算旧上下文
why: 同一对话的 system prompt、summary 和旧消息大多稳定，KV cache 可复用这些前缀。只处理新增尾部会降低 prefill 延迟和输入成本。
why_en: Prefix caching reuses KV state for stable prompt prefixes, reducing prefill latency and repeated input compute.
options_en: Turn Redis Streams into permanent durable storage.
Cache every output token inside a CDN node.
Reduce the number of database rows stored.
Reuse the KV cache for a stable prefix instead of recomputing old context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 推理时缓存已计算的 attention key/value，避免重复计算历史 token。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The KV cache stores already-computed attention keys and values so past tokens are not recomputed.

q: 为什么 rolling summary 不应每一轮都重写？
options: 频繁改写 summary 会让 prompt 前缀失效
summary 一定会比原文更长更详细
Postgres 数据库无法存储 summary
SSE 协议不支持传输 summary 内容
why: prefix caching 依赖稳定前缀；summary 每轮重写会让缓存命中率下降。更好的做法是按较慢 cadence 折叠旧消息。
why_en: Rewriting the summary every turn changes the prefix and defeats prefix-cache reuse.
options_en: Rewriting the summary often changes the prompt prefix and invalidates the prefix cache.
A summary is always longer than the original text.
Postgres cannot store a summary.
SSE does not support summaries.
optionDirectness: 改写前缀会让已缓存的 KV 状态作废
摘要的目的正是比原文短，不是更长
Postgres 能存任意文本，不存在此限制
SSE 只负责传输，不关心内容是不是摘要
optionDirectness_en: Rewriting the prefix invalidates the already-cached KV state.
A summary is meant to be shorter than the original, not longer.
Postgres can store any text, so this is not a real limit.
SSE only transports bytes; it does not care about content.

scenario: 用户点击停止生成；token 下发走 SSE 单向流，不能把取消消息反向塞回同一条 EventSource。
q: 取消一次 Generation 应该怎么做？
options: 关闭浏览器标签页就自动触发取消
POST 一个 cancel 端点，标记状态并通知 worker
等完整 30 秒生成结束后再丢弃
只删除 Redis Stream 就足够了
why: SSE 是单向的，取消走单独 HTTP side-channel。worker 在 token batch 间检查 cancel 信号，看到后把 sequence 从 batch 中移除并释放 GPU。
why_en: Cancellation should be an explicit side-channel request that marks the Generation cancelled and tells the worker to drop the sequence.
whenOtherWins: 双向 WebSocket 可以在同一连接发 stop；但对纯 token 下发，SSE 加 HTTP cancel 更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Cancel[Cancel request] --> Gen[Generation row canceled]
Gen --> Queue[Remove pending job]
Gen --> Worker[Stop active decode]
Worker --> Final[Persist final state]
tradeoff: 显式 side-channel 取消信号 vs 依赖连接关闭
options_en: Closing the browser tab automatically cancels it.
POST a cancel endpoint that marks the status and notifies the worker.
Wait for the full 30-second generation to finish, then discard it.
Just deleting the Redis Stream is enough.

q: 为什么“关闭 tab / 断线”不能等同于取消生成？
options: 因为 Postgres 只在标签页打开时才写入
因为浏览器网络连接永远不会断开
系统支持断线重连和后台继续生成，用户可能回来
因为 Redis Stream 无法设置 TTL 过期
why: Redis Stream 和 SSE reconnect 的目的就是让临时断线不毁掉回答。取消必须是明确用户意图，否则网络抖动会浪费已经排队和生成的工作。
why_en: A dropped connection is not cancellation because the system intentionally supports reconnecting to an ongoing or completed generation.
tradeoff: 网络中断 vs 用户主动取消意图
options_en: Because Postgres only writes while the tab is open.
Because the browser connection never drops.
The system supports reconnecting and keeps generating in the background, so the user may come back.
Because Redis Streams cannot have a TTL.

q: 除了 serving 系统本身，还有哪些方向值得继续深挖？（多选）
options: prompt 与输出的 safety/moderation
模型并行与 GPU 间互联
speculative decoding
把聊天历史完全存在浏览器 cookie
why: 额外方向包括安全审核、模型如何跨多 GPU、speculative decoding、小模型路由/语义缓存、多模态和跨聊天记忆。cookie 不是合理的历史存储方案。
why_en: Additional deep dives include moderation, multi-GPU model serving, speculative decoding, cheaper routing and caching, multimodal input, and cross-chat memory.
options_en: Safety and moderation for prompts and outputs.
Model parallelism and inter-GPU interconnect.
Speculative decoding.
Storing chat history entirely in a browser cookie.

q: speculative decoding 的核心思想是什么？
options: 用 Redis Pub/Sub 直接代替 GPU 计算
把用户的 prompt 拆分给多个数据库处理
先把所有回复内容写进 CDN 节点
小 draft model 先猜 token，大模型一次验证多个
why: decode 是逐 token 的瓶颈，draft model 猜得准时，大模型一次 forward 能确认多个后续 token。它是高级 serving 优化，不是基础 CRUD 能力。
why_en: Speculative decoding lets a small draft model propose tokens that the large model verifies in one step, improving decode throughput when guesses are right.
options_en: Use Redis Pub/Sub instead of a GPU.
Split the user prompt across multiple databases.
Write every reply to a CDN first.
A small draft model guesses several tokens and the big model verifies them in one pass.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用小模型猜测多个 token，让大模型一次验证以减少逐 token 解码次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Speculative decoding uses a small model to guess multiple tokens that the large model verifies in a single pass.

scenario: 部分 prompt 很简单，不需要最大模型；免费用户在高峰期也可以接受轻微质量降级来换取可用性和成本控制。
q: 哪种策略可以降低成本且通常不被用户明显感知？
options: 路由简单请求到小模型，并缓存相似 prompt
所有请求永远使用最大模型处理
把所有 prompt 都延迟到夜间处理
直接删除掉历史上下文内容
why: 模型路由和语义缓存能减少昂贵模型调用，尤其适合简单或重复问题。它还可以和 tier 策略结合，让 free 流量先降级。
why_en: Routing simple prompts to cheaper models and caching semantically similar answers can cut cost without obvious user impact.
whenOtherWins: 高风险、复杂、付费或需要最高质量的请求仍应走强模型；个性化强的回复不适合缓存。
tradeoff: 路由 + 语义缓存降成本 vs 统一走最大模型
options_en: Route simple requests to a smaller model and cache semantically similar prompts.
Always use the largest model for every request.
Delay every prompt to be processed overnight.
Delete the conversation's history context.

q: 单对话 rolling summary 和跨聊天记忆的本质区别是什么？
options: 两者都只依赖浏览器本地缓存
单聊压缩旧轮，跨聊天用 embedding 检索
前者只能用于图片，后者只能用于文本
两者都要求强一致的分布式事务
why: 单对话记忆是把本线程旧内容折叠进 prompt；跨聊天记忆要从许多历史对话中找相关事实。后者更接近检索系统，而不是简单 summary。
why_en: Single-chat summaries compress one thread, while cross-chat memory is a retrieval problem over facts from many conversations.
tradeoff: 单对话摘要压缩 vs 跨对话检索
options_en: Both rely only on browser-local cache.
Single-chat memory compresses old turns; cross-chat memory retrieves facts via embeddings.
The former only works for images, the latter only for text.
Both require strongly consistent distributed transactions.
optionDirectness: 跨聊天记忆需要服务端存储，本地缓存不够
一个是压缩，一个是跨会话检索，机制完全不同
两种记忆都只处理文本，与图片无关
两者都能接受最终一致，不需要分布式事务
optionDirectness_en: Cross-chat memory needs server-side storage, not just local cache.
One compresses a thread, the other retrieves across conversations.
Both kinds of memory operate on text, not images.
Both tolerate eventual consistency, no distributed transaction needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把文本转成向量，用相似度检索相关内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding turns text into a vector so related content can be found by similarity.

q: 把“低延迟且不断流”这一 marquee 决策链排成正确顺序：
steps: 选择 SSE 作为浏览器的单向 token 流
Redis Stream 按 runId 保存短期 delta 供重连补洞
需求：TTFT < 500ms 且流式输出平滑
成本：SSE 单向，取消要走 side-channel
worker 通过 XADD 写 delta，Chat Service XREAD 并转发
why: 先由用户体验确定推送，再由部署和重连问题引出 Redis Stream。取消 side-channel 是选择 SSE 后的可接受成本。
why_en: The streaming decision starts from low TTFT, chooses SSE, adds Redis Streams for reconnect replay, and accepts a side-channel for cancellation.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Need[Low perceived latency] --> SSE[SSE to browser]
SSE --> Stream[Redis Stream resume]
Stream --> Decouple[Decouple workers]
Decouple --> Backpressure[Bounded queue]

q: 把“GPU 受限容量”这一 marquee 决策链排成正确顺序：
steps: 用 bounded queue 和 admission control 给等待时间封顶
需求：20k prompts/sec 峰值且 GPU 昂贵稀缺
用 continuous batching 提高每个 worker 的 GPU 利用率
成本：调度层更复杂，还要定义容量不足时谁被拒绝
在 Chat Service 和 worker 之间放 pull-based queue
why: 先用队列隔离突刺，再用 backpressure 防止无限等待，最后用 continuous batching 榨干 GPU。复杂性主要转移到 serving scheduler 和产品降级策略。
why_en: The GPU-capacity chain adds a pull queue, bounded admission, and continuous batching, paying for more serving complexity.

q: 这个成本量级最直接支持哪个设计判断？
options: GPU 成本可以忽略
只要买一台 GPU 就能服务 120k streams
推理账单可能达到每年数十亿美金量级，所以利用率优化值得投入
成本主要来自 Postgres 存储
why: 文章用公开报道的十亿美金级推理成本做现实锚点，说明每个百分点的 GPU 利用率都是真钱。continuous batching、backpressure 和路由都因此有价值。
why_en: Billion-dollar-scale inference spend makes GPU utilization improvements financially meaningful rather than premature optimization.
scenario: 公开报道显示 OpenAI 2024 年推理算力开销约 18 亿美金，且逐年上升到数十亿美金级。
options_en: GPU cost can be ignored.
One GPU is enough to serve 120k concurrent streams.
Inference bills can reach billions of dollars a year, so utilization work is worth it.
Cost mainly comes from Postgres storage.

q: 中级候选人在这题里至少应主动识别什么问题？
options: 必须能证明 Redis Stream 的内部源码实现
必须完整实现 speculative decoding 算法
必须设计完整的多模态 tokenization 方案
识别 30 秒空白屏问题，知道要 streaming 和排队
why: 中级期望是清楚 API、数据模型和同步 MVP，并能在提示下或主动看到 streaming 与队列。更深的 continuous batching、prefix cache 属于更高层级加分。
why_en: A mid-level answer should recognize that blank-screen synchronous generation needs streaming and that GPU work needs a queue.
options_en: Prove out the internal source of Redis Streams.
Fully implement speculative decoding.
Design a complete multimodal tokenization scheme.
Recognize the 30-second blank-screen problem and know it needs streaming plus a queue.

q: Senior 候选人的重点深度通常落在哪里？
options: SSE vs WebSocket、GPU 调度与成本
只画一张 REST CRUD 流程图
只讨论前端 UI 文案细节
只讨论数据库范式设计
why: Senior 要快速过高层设计，把时间放在流式 fanout、GPU 调度、公平性和上下文成本。能讲清协议与调度取舍是关键。
why_en: Senior candidates should move quickly into streaming fanout, GPU scheduling, fairness, and context-cost trade-offs.
options_en: SSE vs WebSocket, GPU scheduling, and long-conversation cost control.
Draw only one REST CRUD diagram.
Discuss only frontend UI copy.
Discuss only database normalization.
optionDirectness: 覆盖协议取舍、调度和成本三个深挖点
只停在功能性设计，没碰非功能要求
文案不是这题的技术评分点
范式设计不是本题的核心难点
optionDirectness_en: Covers protocol trade-offs, scheduling, and cost in depth.
Stops at functional design, skips the non-functional asks.
Copy details are not what this question grades.
Normalization is not the core difficulty here.

q: Staff+ 答案区别于普通答案的标志是什么？
options: 只是列出更多数据库产品名字
把 GPU 经济性、调度、公平和降级串成一个整体
刻意避免任何数字估算过程
把强一致性当成默认设计目标
why: Staff+ 需要带来超出模板的 serving 深度，尤其是 GPU 成本、推理内部优化和降级策略之间的连接。文章明确提到 speculative decoding 等知识也逐渐成为常识。
why_en: A staff-level answer connects GPU economics, batching, KV-cache reuse, tiered fairness, and graceful degradation into one serving architecture.
options_en: Just list more database product names.
Weave GPU economics, scheduling, fairness, and degradation into one coherent story.
Deliberately avoid any numeric estimation.
Treat strong consistency as the default goal.

q: 最终设计相比同步 MVP 增加了哪些关键组件？（多选）
options: SSE + Redis Stream 的 runId token 流
bounded queue、admission control 和 continuous batching worker
per-user token budgets 与 tier-aware priority queue
把每个 token 永久写入数据库作为唯一真相
why: 最终架构补上了 streaming、GPU 调度公平、上下文成本三块；每 token 落库仍不在范围内，只持久化最终 assistant message。
why_en: The final architecture adds resumable streaming, bounded GPU scheduling with batching, and cost-aware tiered fairness, not durable storage for every token.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] -->|POST prompt| Chat[Chat Service]
Client -->|SSE runId| Chat
Chat --> DB[(Postgres)]
Chat --> Queue[Bounded Queue]
Worker[GPU Workers] -->|XADD deltas| Stream[(Redis Stream)]
Chat -->|XREAD| Stream
Queue --> Worker
options_en: An SSE plus Redis Stream token flow keyed by runId.
A bounded queue with admission control and continuous-batching workers.
Per-user token budgets plus a tier-aware priority queue.
Permanently writing every token to the database as the source of truth.
optionDirectness: 解决低 TTFT 和断线重连补洞
解决 GPU 调度、过载保护和利用率
解决公平性和付费优先级
违反「只持久化最终消息」的范围设定
optionDirectness_en: Solves low TTFT and gap-free reconnects.
Solves GPU scheduling, overload protection, and utilization.
Solves fairness and paid-tier priority.
Violates the scope of persisting only the final message.
